configuration: LinuxRunner Release 1.1.0 build 900, ARM64 interpreter, JIT disabled, virgl compiled
workload: Idle default Openbox + LXQt panel + PCManFM-Qt X11 desktop, Xvfb/RFB, 960x540, Core Graphics presenter, socket image capture, default VNC timing
provenance: Same preserved local integration source tree. Before reverses the three-file storage runtime diff from d141978 to 0d015d3; after restores it. The native Unix-socket path fix and graphics/test instrumentation are identical in both and are outside the storage PR. Storage walks all installed roots; this is not an Arch-only filesystem benchmark.
sampling: Second through fourth scheduled fifteen-second cumulative getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) user+system CPU / CLOCK_MONOTONIC samples, approximately 30-60 seconds after native sampling began. The test waits 70 seconds after readiness; the xterm broker waits 75 seconds before launch. No pointer/key events in the selected window; thermal_state 0 is nominal.

before.physical_ui_test: PASS: desktop ready, managed xterm launch, synthesized touch/text and visible LR REF INPUT aarch64 output

after.physical_ui_test: PASS: desktop ready, managed xterm launch, synthesized touch/text and visible LR REF INPUT aarch64 output

source_manifest_comparison.comparison: 676 source/control files checked from the working tree during the corresponding builds; only the three storage runtime files differ. Not a binary-equivalence proof.

limits: One sequential before/after pair, without randomized order or repeat trials.
Storage accounting includes the coinstalled SteamOS and Alpine roots.
A quiet process CPU measurement does not establish sustained performance, FPS, input latency, battery life or a hardware-keyboard result.
Both physical UI tests use synthesized touch/text; native terminal identity was separately recorded.
The local integration source snapshots and raw receipts are retained privately; the storage PR is not a self-contained public integration reproduction kit.
